text: GAIG (Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group Co., Ltd.) is the controlling shareholder of GAC Group, holding approximately 54.02% of the company, and the ultimate controller of the company is the Guangzhou State-Owned Assets Administration Bureau, a department directly under the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government that performs the investor's role on its behalf.
short: GAC Group is controlled by the Guangzhou municipal government: GAIG holds 54.02%; the ultimate controller is the Guangzhou State-Owned Assets Administration Bureau.

source.name: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. Annual Report 2025 (H-share, HKEX), Changes in Shares and Information on Shareholders, ultimate-controller note
source.quote: GAIG is the controlling shareholder of the Company, holding approximately 54.02% of the Company’s equity interest

additionalSources.name: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. 2025 Annual Report (A-share, cninfo), Share Changes and Shareholders, actual-controller note and control-chain diagram
additionalSources.quote: 本公司實際控制人為廣州市人民政府國有資產監督管理委員會，是廣州市人民政府直屬機構，經廣州市人民政府授權，代表廣州市人民政府履行出資人職責
additionalSources.note: Chinese A-share filing of the same annual report (different regulator, different host): names the Guangzhou Municipal SASAC as actual controller, holding 90% of Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group, which holds 54.02% of GAC Group.
